mapper.sql: select f.feedback_id, f.trace_code, f.bottling_id, b.batch_no, e.enterprise_name, p.product_name, f.rating, f.content, f.is_suspicious, f.status, f.reply_content, f.del_flag, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time from trace_feedback f left join trace_bottling_info bi on bi.bottling_id = f.bottling_id left join trace_batch b on b.batch_id = bi.batch_id left join trace_product p on p.product_id = b.product_id left join trace_vineyard_plot vp on vp.plot_id = b.plot_id left join trace_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = vp.enterprise_id
